precepts.text: The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law. That is the secret of God upon Job's tabernacle, and the relationship between Job and us.
precepts.point: If I laughed on them, they believed it not: Job had an austere spirit. I chose out their way: he counseled and directed them. And sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners. Job sat like a king in the army.

note.label: Job Sees America's 250th Anniversary

precepts.why:
“As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle”. What is the secret of God? This shows the relationship between Job and us.

“The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.”

God reveals his secrets to the Israelites. The things revealed belong to us and to our children for ever, and they are revealed for a purpose: that we may do all the words of this law. The secret of God was upon Job’s tabernacle because he was of that people, and he kept that law.

precepts.text: As the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, so shall your seed and your name remain: the righteous of our people that make it. From one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me. And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched. Go forth where? To look on this place. A carcase is supposed to disappear after death; this is letting you know it is something spiritual: they are in damnation, being tormented. There is a place of torment, and it is set up when Christ returns; Christ has the power over hell and death.

precepts.why:
Deuteronomy 29:22 speaks of “the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you”. Who is that? Isaiah 66 shows it: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name remain.” The seed and the name that remain in the new heaven and new earth are the righteous of our people that make it, those of us that get the kingdom.

“And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord.” After they come up to worship, “they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me”. Go forth where? To look on this place, America. That is the same moment Deuteronomy 29 describes, when the generation to come and the stranger from a far land see the plagues of that land, “brimstone, and salt, and burning”, and ask, “Wherefore hath the Lord done thus unto this land?”

After somebody dies, their carcase is supposed to just disappear. So this is letting you know it is something spiritual. “for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.” They are in damnation, cast in hell, being tormented. That is why Deuteronomy 29 says the Lord will separate the man that did not repent unto evil.

There is a place of torment, and it will be set up when Christ returns. After this place is destroyed physically, a spiritual prison and damnation will be set up here, the place of torment for the devils that said, have you come to torment us before our time. Christ has the power over hell and death: he can give you life and immortality, or wake you up and torment you.

precepts.why:
Christ has the power over life and death, which is why Daniel 12 says some shall awake. “And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.”

Many of them are going to awake. Some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt. When you die, you go to sleep, yes. But Christ has the power to wake your behind up and torment you.

That is what stands behind the carcases of Isaiah 66:24, whose worm does not die and whose fire is not quenched, and behind the land of Deuteronomy 29 that is all brimstone, salt and burning. Those who forsook the covenant of the Lord God of their fathers and served other gods do not simply die and disappear: they are awakened to shame and everlasting contempt. As 2 Esdras 9 says, read in the same moment, those who despised his law while the place of repentance was open “must know it after death by pain.” And the righteous awake to everlasting life, the seed and the name that remain.

precepts.point: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder and trample the dragon, the nations. Because he hath set his love upon me, I will deliver him, set him on high, answer him, be with him in trouble, and with long life satisfy him and shew him my salvation.

note.label: Edom's Achilles' Heel

precepts.why:
“He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” The secret place of the Most High is the Bible. Moses says so: “The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.” God's word is his secrets, and what he has revealed of it belongs to Israel and our children forever, so that we may do his law.

So dwelling in the secret place means living in his word and keeping it. That is why “his truth shall be thy shield and buckler”: his law is thy shield and buckler. The one who dwells there can say “He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.”

That is who the psalm protects when destruction comes. And it is coming, though some do not believe it because of God bless the USA, nothing could ever happen here. Job says “neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh”, because the Lord is telling us it is going to come. The arrow that flieth by day is the missile, and the destruction that wasteth at noonday tells you the time.

“A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee. Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.” The only reason we will see that and not be touched is “Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation”: because we dwell in the secret place, his word and his law.

precepts.text: Keep the words of the covenant and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.
precepts.point: He rebels against the king of Assyria and smites the Philistines even unto Gaza.

note.label: 2 Kings 18: Hezekiah and the Assyrian Threat

precepts.why:
“Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.”

Hezekiah “clave to the Lord, and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the Lord commanded Moses. And the Lord was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth.”

Prospering here does not mean a mansion or luxury. It is the blessing that comes from keeping and doing the commandments: the Most High with him, rebelling against the king of Assyria and serving him not, and smiting the Philistines even unto Gaza.

points: The Lord will not spare him, but then the anger of the Lord and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the Lord shall blot out his name from under heaven. Any of our people that hear the words of this covenant and reject it, the Lord says he will blot their name out of the book.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

points: And the Lord shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel. This is something heavy: this is talking about judgment in the future.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

points: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land. What land? Some of you think Moses is talking about the land of Israel. No: he is talking about spiritual Egypt, America. Moses saw America being destroyed and recorded it here.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

points: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah. Remember, this place is spiritually called Sodom: the same way Sodom and Gomorrah were destroyed with fire, this place will be destroyed with fire when Christ returns in the new Passover.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

points: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the Lord done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger? The nations left in the future will look on America and ask that; it is the same picture as Isaiah 66. Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt. When we came out of Egypt the Lord made a covenant with us, and we broke it.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

points: And the Lord rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation: that is the land of Israel, 70 AD; and cast them into another land, as it is this day. That other land is the land of Deuteronomy 28:68, the land that burns in the verses above.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

points: The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us. What was just went over is a secret thing that Moses understood: he understood we would be brought into spiritual Egypt, into America, and he saw America destroyed.

note.label: Passover Class: Exodus From America Modern Day Egypt

points: The secret things belong unto the Lord our God, but those things which are revealed belong unto us, and to our children for ever.
Understanding God's mysteries and his laws is a lineage thing, a birthright; you cannot come in as a good heathen and learn the secrets of the Bible.
And it is revealed that we may do all the words of this law, not to be held and admired.

note.label: Escape Thankskilling : Oh God & My Lord

points: These are the words of the covenant which the Lord commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: Ye have seen all that the Lord did before your eyes in the land of Egypt, the great temptations, the signs, and those great miracles.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: Yet the Lord hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day. Moses is telling them: you do not truly understand what Deuteronomy 28 means; you do not know how bad it is really going to get.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: The Most High led Israel forty years in the wilderness; their clothes waxed not old upon them, nor their shoes upon their feet, that they might know that he is the Lord their God.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out against Israel, and Israel smote them and gave their land for an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: Keep therefore the words of this covenant and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: All Israel stood that day before the Lord: captains, elders, officers, little ones, wives, and the stranger in the camp, from the hewer of wood unto the drawer of water. Even the servants among us heard this covenant.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: The purpose: that he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, as he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob. That is who we come from.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath, but also with him that is not here with us this day. That is us: the Lord made this covenant with the generations which were to come.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: Ye have seen the abominations and idols of the nations, wood and stone, silver and gold; lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turneth away from the Lord to serve the gods of these nations.
Lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood: destruction.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: Verse 19 is Christianity 101: when he heareth the words of this curse, he blesseth himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart. He hears the whole of Deuteronomy 28, the ships, the children given away, the no rest and no ease, and says in his mind, I am an American, I live under the blessings of God, while he catches the bus, pays rent, and drinks dirty water in Flint.
To add drunkenness to thirst: the Most High says you are drunk with that dumb understanding, lying to yourself, and thirstier for it.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: The Lord will not spare him; the anger of the Lord and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses written in this book shall lie upon him, and the Lord shall blot out his name from under heaven: death.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: The generation to come and the stranger from a far land shall see the plagues of the land, the whole land brimstone, salt, and burning, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboim.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: All nations shall say, Wherefore hath the Lord done thus unto this land? And men shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord God of their fathers.

That is what they say when they look at our people: the ones who know we are the real Israelites say, they forsook God and now they are being punished; but we are not going to tell them who they are, because we are living good while they suffer.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: The Lord rooted them out of their land in anger and cast them into another land, as it is this day. Welcome to Babylon the great.

note.label: Deuteronomy 29: The Covenant Made with Us Who Were Not There

points: The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: those are the prophecies, which Deuteronomy 30 goes into a little.

But those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law. The revealed things, the milk, are the laws that are easy to be understood, and they belong to us; focus on those.
